parent_objective: materialize shared guarded repair configs with M2298 target/guardrail gates
blocked_by: M2301 freezes guarded repair config materialization route
supersedes: direct training before guarded repair config materialization

public_gates: M2302 must not run reset or rollout
M2302 must not train or run PPO
M2302 must materialize exactly 15 configs across 5 profiles and 3 seeds
M2302 must preserve P0 actor input contract and not widen track_width
M2302 must copy or encode the M2298 repair_gate_spec
M2302 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use profile_name or profile_seed as repair targets
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes executable guarded repair configs and matrix for later measured evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: config materialization only; no rollout training ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if source configs are missing
stop if actor contract violations appear
stop if the M2298 gate spec cannot be copied or encoded
fallback_plan: route to source-config audit if source configs are missing
route to design repair if contract or track-width gates fail
route to guarded repair training execution design if materialization passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2301 admits guarded repair config materialization

allowed_updates: M2302 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by materialization
next_stage_criteria: actor contract violation count is zero
repair gate spec is copied or encoded
next non-ranking training execution route is pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2302 materializes configs and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2302.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat config materialization as infrastructure, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates an executable config pack that can produce new measured evidence in the next route

must_synthesize_if: M2302 changes actor inputs or scenario specs
M2302 does not route to measured evidence

hypothesis: M2301 guarded repair design can be materialized as a 15-config shared-reward config pack without actor-contract, track-width, profile-tuning, or claim-boundary violations.
success_criteria: no reset rollout training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim is made
failure_criteria: M2302 changes actor inputs or scenario specs
M2302 uses profile_name/profile_seed as repair targets
M2302 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2302 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2302 passes if it materializes a clean guarded repair config pack and pre-registers the next non-ranking execution route.
